name: cognitive-substrate
description: Cognitive Substrate runtime (W033, the agent-body structure pattern): the typed contracts for an agent's MIND — the part that decides. A substrate is a PURE decision function over observed body views (the W032 A7-bounded BodyView + granted content — the only input type) producing a DecisionStream of proposed world commands, each carrying its rationale as data (rule + input signals, never private chain-of-thought) and a declared confidence citing the view's content digest (the W028 chain discipline). Stateless-per-view or a seeded state machine (same views + same seed ⇒ same decisions, A9); fail-closed (content beyond the view grant, future-dated content and unavailable artifacts are typed errors, never silently seen); no direct world access (the substrate proposes, the Body executes — never a port call). Ships the loud validators (observed view, descriptor, decision stream vs the body's embodiment) and two reference minds: a rule-following momentum substrate (declared-state) and a mean-reversion substrate (stateless-per-view), both seeded.
